methodology.decisions: Counts explicit DEV opportunity resolutions; does not count React menu render events.
methodology.presentedEpisodes: Existing canonical moment clustering sampled at 4 Hz and every decision, filtered by key_player; excludes UI lead-in/window/proxy/abort execution.
methodology.touches: PR149 discrete contact totals and PR150 public continuous-control totals intentionally have different definitions.
methodology.receptionMomentum: Optional canonical retention metadata is available only in PR150; velocities are pre/post tick snapshots, not exact physical-contact substeps. Old reports may omit these fields.
methodology.rendererCalls: Zero by construction in this headless harness; independent observer/render/replay parity checks are required.
methodology.timingNote: Raw timings retained; ratios suppressed because task/test concurrency and/or instrument differences prevent a controlled timing claim.
methodology.anomalies: Descriptive flags identify suspicious samples; thresholds are reporting labels and never football quotas.
methodology.missingValues: Null means not captured or unavailable, never zero.
methodology.precision: Reported rates, quality and velocity summaries are rounded to four decimal places; elapsed time and canonical speed to two. Canonical fingerprints retain full precision.
